reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked precondition pattern and APIError, but adds a parallel guard that each of the six provider functions must remember to call rather than one combined link precondition.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is defined once; only its one-line call is repeated in the six per-provider link functions, mirroring how the tree already repeats ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the existing linking precondition in accounts/app.ts and runs before any write or sync call.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear named helper, but a seventh provider would need to add two separate guard calls by hand since there is no shared link path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link handler (goCardless, simpleFin, fintegra, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking) calls ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic copied; only call lines repeat.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link functions.
